hook: A classified mission report (MISREP) from the 482nd Attack Squadron documents a brief UAP sighting over Iraq on December 1, 2022, during a 19-hour ISR mission under Operation Inherent Resolve, in which the crew observed one object flying west to east but did not divert to investigate.
why_it_matters: This report illustrates the standard military UAP reporting pipeline in action: a USCENTCOM unit files a MISREP that flows to AARO, the office stood up specifically to consolidate such reports. The crew's own characterization of the object as a 'possible UAP/UAV' — explicitly hedging between anomalous and conventional — reflects the ambiguity typical of operational UAP encounters. The decision not to follow the object and continue the assigned tasking means the sighting was not further characterized, leaving the resolution open.

key_findings.finding: The crew observed one object flying west to east at 1620Z and explicitly labeled it a 'possible UAP/UAV,' leaving open whether it was anomalous or a conventional unmanned aerial vehicle.
